name: Contamination Protocol
source:
The Captain of the Soft Touch is dead. Her mission brought to a catastrophic halt at the hands of an unknown attacker and forced back into spaceflight, her crew scrambles to make sense of what has happened.

One of two surviving witnesses, your navigator, has been forced into quarantine due to her exposure to the source of the attack. It's up to you, the mission's doctor, to ensure she hasn't been contaminated.

Learn the enemy's face. Save your marriage. Ask the right questions, get the right answers. Whatever it takes.

[From [url=https://saoirsedotexe.itch.io/contamination-protocol]itch.io[/url]]
